title: English Practice Quiz 0857
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What is a travel itinerary?
options: A planned schedule of a journey
questions.explanation: An itinerary lists journey details and timing.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What is a booking reference used for?
options: Identify a reservation or travel booking
questions.explanation: The reference helps locate the booking.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What does a consignment note record?
questions.explanation: A consignment note accompanies and describes transported goods.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What is a route contingency?
options: An alternative plan if the planned route is unavailable
questions.explanation: A contingency provides an alternative when plans fail.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: A shipment is delayed. What is the best response?
options: Inform affected parties and obtain an updated estimate

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What should a pre-journey vehicle inspection include?
Travel and Logistics: What is a waybill?
options: A document detailing a shipment and its movement
questions.explanation: A waybill accompanies goods in transit.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What is a logistics bottleneck?
options: A point that slows the flow of goods or work
questions.explanation: A bottleneck restricts the flow of work.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What does a delivery window refer to?
options: The expected time range for delivery
questions.explanation: It specifies the expected delivery time range.

questions.question: Travel and Logistics: What should a receiver do when goods arrive?
options: Record shortages or damage before confirming receipt
